nplcit.othercit: A. Author, “Drift in optical sensors,” Journal of Examples, 2001.

abstract.p: A housing holds an optical sensor and a sealed reference surface. When measured drift exceeds a threshold, the sensor recalibrates against the reference surface.

description.p: The housing 10 includes an optical sensor 12 and a reference surface 14 sealed in a chamber.
A controller compares the reading of the reference surface with a stored value & records the drift.

claim.claim-text: 1. A sensor assembly comprising: a housing; an optical sensor disposed in the housing; and a reference surface sealed in a chamber of the housing, wherein the optical sensor recalibrates against the reference surface when drift exceeds a threshold.
2. The sensor assembly of claim 1, wherein the threshold is stored in a controller.
3. A method of calibrating an optical sensor, comprising: measuring a reference surface; computing drift; and recalibrating when the drift exceeds a threshold.
